_legend: Short vowels: a e i o u (u as in "put"). Long vowels: ah ay ee oh oo (pure, held longer; "ay" with no glide). ew = Latin eu as one syllable (e+oo). CAPS = stressed syllable. w = Latin v; k = c (always hard); g always hard; gn sounds like ngn (magnus = MANG-nus; at the start of a word it is g+n); p/t/k after an aspirated ph/th/ch are breathy p/t/k, NOT f/th. z = dz (Allen; some sources give a long z between vowels).

r-vulg-john-1-5.latin: In prīncipiō erat Verbum, et Verbum erat apud Deum, et Deus erat Verbum. Hoc erat in prīncipiō apud Deum. Omnia per ipsum facta sunt, et sine ipsō factum est nihil quod factum est. In ipsō vīta erat, et vīta erat lūx hominum. Et lūx in tenebrīs lūcet, et tenebrae eam nōn conprehendērunt.

r-vulg-genesis-1-5.latin: In prīncipiō creāvit Deus caelum et terram. Terra autem erat inānis et vacua, et tenebrae erant super faciem abyssī, et spīritus Deī ferēbātur super aquās. Dīxitque Deus: “Fīat lūx.” Et facta est lūx. Et vīdit Deus lūcem quod esset bona, et dīvīsit lūcem ā tenebrīs. Appellāvitque lūcem Diem, et tenebrās Noctem; factumque est vespere et māne, diēs ūnus.

q-virgil-felix.latin: Fēlīx quī potuit rērum cognōscere causās.

q-bernard-nanos.ipa: /diː.ˈkeː.bat bɛr.ˈnar.dʊs kar.nɔ.ˈteːn.sɪs noːs ˈɛs.sɛ ˈkʷa.sɪ ˈnaː.noːs gɪ.ˈgan.tʊm ˈʊ.mɛ.riːs iːn.sɪ.ˈdɛn.teːs/
q-bernard-nanos.respelling: dee-KAY-bat ber-NAR-dus kar-no-TAYN-sis nohs ES-se KWA-si NAH-nohs gi-GAN-tum U-me-rees een-si-DEN-tays
q-bernard-nanos.latin: Dīcēbat Bernardus Carnotēnsis nōs esse quasi nānōs, gigantum umerīs īnsidentēs.

q-vegetius-pacem.respelling: I-gi-tur kwee day-SEE-de-rat PAH-kem PREYE-pa-ret BEL-lum
q-vegetius-pacem.latin: Igitur quī dēsīderat pācem, praeparet bellum.

q-caesar-garumna.ipa: /ˈgal.loːs ab a.kʷiː.ˈtaː.niːs ga.ˈrʊm.na ˈfluː.mɛn aː ˈbɛl.giːs ˈma.trɔ.na ɛt ˈseː.kʷa.na ˈdiː.wɪ.dɪt/
q-caesar-garumna.respelling: GAL-lohs ab a-kwee-TAH-nees ga-RUM-na FLOO-men ah BEL-gees MA-tro-na et SAY-kwa-na DEE-wi-dit
q-caesar-garumna.latin: Gallōs ab Aquītānīs Garumna flūmen, ā Belgīs Matrona et Sēquana dīvidit.

q-caesar-castra-movent.ipa: /ˈpɔs.tɛ.roː ˈdɪ.eː ˈkas.tra ɛks ˈɛ.oː ˈlɔ.koː ˈmɔ.wɛnt/
q-caesar-castra-movent.respelling: POS-te-roh DI-ay KAS-tra eks E-oh LO-koh MO-went
q-caesar-castra-movent.latin: Posterō diē castra ex eō locō movent.

q-seneca-si-vales.respelling: see WA-lays BE-ne est E-go WA-le-oh
q-seneca-si-vales.latin: Sī valēs, bene est; ego valeō.

v-milites-aedificant.respelling: MEE-li-tays AR-bo-rays KEYE-dunt et KAS-tra eye-DI-fi-kant
v-milites-aedificant.latin: Mīlitēs arborēs caedunt et castra aedificant.

q-martial-thais.ipa: /ˈtʰaː.ɪs ˈha.bɛt ˈnɪ.groːs ˈnɪ.wɛ.oːs lae̯.ˈka.nɪ.a ˈdɛn.teːs kʷae̯ ˈra.tɪ.oː ɛst ˈeːmp.toːs hae̯k ˈha.bɛt ˈɪl.la ˈsʊ.oːs/
q-martial-thais.respelling: TAH-is HA-bet NI-grohs NI-we-ohs leye-KA-ni-a DEN-tays kweye RA-ti-oh est AYMP-tohs heyek HA-bet IL-la SU-ohs
q-martial-thais.ipa_verse: /ˈtʰaː.ɪs ˈha.bɛt ˈnɪ.groːs ˈnɪ.wɛ.oːs lae̯.ˈka.nɪ.a ˈdɛn.teːs kʷae̯ ˈra.tɪ.oː‿st ˈeːmp.toːs hae̯k ˈha.bɛt ˈɪl.la ˈsʊ.oːs/
q-martial-thais.respelling_verse: TAH-is HA-bet NI-grohs NI-we-ohs leye-KA-ni-a DEN-tays kweye RA-ti-oh'st AYMP-tohs heyek HA-bet IL-la SU-ohs
q-martial-thais.latin: Thāis habet nigrōs, niveōs Laecania dentēs. Quae ratiō est? Ēmptōs haec habet, illa suōs.

q-juvenal-rara-avis.ipa: /ˈraː.ra ˈa.wɪs ɪn ˈtɛr.riːs nɪ.ˈgroː.kʷɛ sɪ.ˈmɪl.lɪ.ma ˈkʏk.noː/
q-juvenal-rara-avis.respelling: RAH-ra A-wis in TER-rees ni-GROH-kwe si-MIL-li-ma KÜK-noh
q-juvenal-rara-avis.latin: Rāra avis in terrīs nigrōque simillima cycnō

q-tacitus-reges.ipa: /ˈreː.geːs ɛks noː.bɪ.lɪ.ˈtaː.tɛ ˈdʊ.keːs ɛks wɪr.ˈtuː.tɛ ˈsuː.mʊnt/
q-tacitus-reges.respelling: RAY-gays eks noh-bi-li-TAH-te DU-kays eks wir-TOO-te SOO-munt
q-tacitus-reges.latin: Rēgēs ex nōbilitāte, ducēs ex virtūte sūmunt.

q-horace-ibam.ipa: /ˈiː.bam ˈfɔr.tɛ ˈwɪ.aː ˈsa.kraː ˈsiː.kʊt ˈmɛ.ʊs ɛst moːs/
q-horace-ibam.respelling: EE-bam FOR-te WI-ah SA-krah SEE-kut ME-us est mohs
q-horace-ibam.ipa_verse: /ˈiː.bãː ˈfɔr.tɛ ˈwɪ.aː ˈsa.kraː ˈsiː.kʊt ˈmɛ.ʊs ɛst moːs/
q-horace-ibam.respelling_verse: EE-bahn FOR-te WI-ah SA-krah SEE-kut ME-us est mohs
q-horace-ibam.latin: Ībam forte viā Sacrā, sīcut meus est mōs

q-martial-diaulus.ipa: /ˈnuː.pɛr ˈɛ.rat ˈmɛ.dɪ.kʊs nʊŋk ɛst wɪs.ˈpɪl.loː dɪ.ˈau̯.lʊs kʷɔd wɪs.ˈpɪl.loː ˈfa.kɪt ˈfeː.kɛ.rat ɛt ˈmɛ.dɪ.kʊs/
q-martial-diaulus.respelling: NOO-per E-rat ME-di-kus nungk est wis-PIL-loh di-OW-lus kwod wis-PIL-loh FA-kit FAY-ke-rat et ME-di-kus
q-martial-diaulus.latin: Nūper erat medicus, nunc est vispillō Diaulus: quod vispillō facit, fēcerat et medicus.

q-resgestae-bis-ovans.ipa: /bɪs ˈɔ.waːns trɪ.ʊm.ˈpʰaː.wiː triːs ˈeː.giː kʊ.ˈruː.liːs trɪ.ˈʊm.pʰoːs/
q-resgestae-bis-ovans.respelling: bis O-wahns tri-um-PAH-wee trees AY-gee ku-ROO-lees tri-UM-pohs
q-resgestae-bis-ovans.latin: Bis ovāns triumphāvī, trīs ēgī curūlīs triumphōs.

q-pliny-misenum.respelling: E-rat mee-SAY-nee klas-SEM-kwe im-PE-ri-oh PREYE-sayns re-GAY-bat
q-pliny-misenum.latin: Erat Mīsēnī classemque imperiō praesēns regēbat.

q-martial-pauper.ipa: /ˈsɛm.pɛr ˈpau̯.pɛr ˈɛ.rɪs siː ˈpau̯.pɛr ɛs ae̯.mɪ.lɪ.ˈaː.nɛ ˈdan.tʊr ˈɔ.peːs ˈnuːl.liːs nʊŋk ˈnɪ.sɪ diː.ˈwɪ.tɪ.bʊs/
q-martial-pauper.respelling: SEM-per POW-per E-ris see POW-per es eye-mi-li-AH-ne DAN-tur O-pays NOOL-lees nungk NI-si dee-WI-ti-bus
q-martial-pauper.latin: Semper pauper eris, sī pauper es, Aemiliāne: dantur opēs nūllīs nunc nisi dīvitibus.

q-seneca-naturam.respelling: proh-PO-si-tum NOS-trum est se-KUN-dum nah-TOO-ram WEE-we-re
q-seneca-naturam.latin: Prōpositum nostrum est secundum nātūram vīvere.

q-seneca-brevitas.ipa: /noːn ɛk.ˈsɪ.gʊ.ʊm ˈtɛm.pɔ.rɪs ha.ˈbeː.mʊs sɛd ˈmʊl.tʊm pɛr.ˈdɪ.dɪ.mʊs/
q-seneca-brevitas.respelling: nohn ek-SI-gu-um TEM-po-ris ha-BAY-mus sed MUL-tum per-DI-di-mus
q-seneca-brevitas.latin: Nōn exiguum temporis habēmus, sed multum perdidimus.

q-lucretius-mors.ipa: /niːl ˈɪ.gɪ.tʊr mɔrs ɛst ad noːs ˈnɛ.kʷɛ ˈpɛr.tɪ.nɛt ˈhiː.lʊm/
q-lucretius-mors.respelling: neel I-gi-tur mors est ad nohs NE-kwe PER-ti-net HEE-lum
q-lucretius-mors.ipa_verse: /niːl ˈɪ.gɪ.tʊr mɔrs ɛst ad noːs ˈnɛ.kʷɛ ˈpɛr.tɪ.nɛt ˈhiː.lũː/
q-lucretius-mors.respelling_verse: neel I-gi-tur mors est ad nohs NE-kwe PER-ti-net HEE-loon
q-lucretius-mors.latin: Nīl igitur mors est ad nōs neque pertinet hīlum.

q-cicero-socrates-caelo.ipa: /ˈsoː.kra.teːs ˈau̯.tɛm ˈpriː.mʊs pʰɪ.lɔ.ˈsɔ.pʰɪ.am deː.wɔ.ˈkaː.wɪt eː ˈkae̯.loː ɛt ɪn ˈʊr.bɪ.bʊs kɔn.lɔ.ˈkaː.wɪt/
q-cicero-socrates-caelo.respelling: SOH-kra-tays OW-tem PREE-mus pi-lo-SO-pi-am day-wo-KAH-wit ay KEYE-loh et in UR-bi-bus kon-lo-KAH-wit
q-cicero-socrates-caelo.latin: Sōcratēs autem prīmus philosophiam dēvocāvit ē caelō et in urbibus conlocāvit.

q-cicero-commentatio.ipa: /ˈtoː.ta ˈɛ.nɪm pʰɪ.lɔ.sɔ.ˈpʰoː.rʊm ˈwiː.ta ʊt ˈa.ɪt ˈɪ.dɛm kɔm.mɛn.ˈtaː.tɪ.oː ˈmɔr.tɪs ɛst/
q-cicero-commentatio.respelling: TOH-ta E-nim pi-lo-so-POH-rum WEE-ta ut A-it I-dem kom-men-TAH-ti-oh MOR-tis est
q-cicero-commentatio.latin: Tōta enim philosophōrum vīta, ut ait idem, commentātiō mortis est.

q-tertullian-semen.ipa: /ˈpluː.reːs ɛf.ˈfɪ.kɪ.mʊr ˈkʷɔ.tɪ.eːns ˈmɛ.tɪ.mʊr aː ˈwoː.biːs ˈseː.mɛn ɛst ˈsaŋ.gʷɪs kʰriːs.tɪ.aː.ˈnoː.rʊm/
q-tertullian-semen.respelling: PLOO-rays ef-FI-ki-mur KWO-ti-ayns ME-ti-mur ah WOH-bees SAY-men est SANG-gwis krees-ti-ah-NOH-rum
q-tertullian-semen.latin: Plūrēs efficimur, quotiēns metimur ā vōbīs: sēmen est sanguis Chrīstiānōrum.

q-tertullian-athenis.ipa: /kʷɪd ˈɛr.goː a.ˈtʰeː.niːs ɛt hɪ.ɛ.rɔ.ˈsɔ.lʏ.miːs kʷɪd a.ka.ˈdeː.mɪ.ae̯ ɛt ɛk.ˈkleː.sɪ.ae̯/
q-tertullian-athenis.respelling: kwid ER-goh a-TAY-nees et hi-e-ro-SO-lü-mees kwid a-ka-DAY-mi-eye et ek-KLAY-si-eye
q-tertullian-athenis.latin: Quid ergō Athēnīs et Hierosolymīs? Quid acadēmiae et ecclēsiae?

q-perpetua-christiana.ipa: /hɪ.la.rɪ.ˈaː.nʊs kʰriːs.tɪ.ˈaː.na ɛs ˈɪŋ.kʷɪt ɛt ˈɛ.gɔ rɛs.ˈpɔn.diː kʰriːs.tɪ.ˈaː.na sʊm/
q-perpetua-christiana.respelling: hi-la-ri-AH-nus krees-ti-AH-na es ING-kwit et E-go res-PON-dee krees-ti-AH-na sum
q-perpetua-christiana.latin: Hilariānus: "Chrīstiāna es?" inquit. Et ego respondī: "Chrīstiāna sum."

q-augustine-carthago.ipa: /ˈweː.niː kar.ˈtʰaː.gɪ.nɛm ɛt kɪr.kʊms.trɛ.ˈpeː.bat meː ˈʊn.dɪ.kʷɛ sar.ˈtaː.goː flaː.gɪ.tɪ.oː.ˈsoː.rʊm a.ˈmoː.rʊm/
q-augustine-carthago.respelling: WAY-nee kar-TAH-gi-nem et kir-kums-tre-PAY-bat may UN-di-kwe sar-TAH-goh flah-gi-ti-oh-SOH-rum a-MOH-rum
q-augustine-carthago.latin: Vēnī Carthāginem, et circumstrepēbat mē undique sartāgō flāgitiōsōrum amōrum.

q-boethius-infortunii.ipa: /ɪn ˈɔm.niː ad.wɛr.sɪ.ˈtaː.tɛ fɔr.ˈtuː.nae̯ iːn.feː.liː.ˈkɪs.sɪ.mʊm ɛst ˈgɛ.nʊs iːn.fɔr.ˈtuː.nɪ.iː fʊ.ˈɪs.sɛ feː.ˈliː.kɛm/
q-boethius-infortunii.respelling: in OM-nee ad-wer-si-TAH-te for-TOO-neye een-fay-lee-KIS-si-mum est GE-nus een-for-TOO-ni-ee fu-IS-se fay-LEE-kem
q-boethius-infortunii.latin: In omnī adversitāte fortūnae īnfēlīcissimum est genus īnfortūniī fuisse fēlīcem.

q-vulg-verbum-caro.ipa: /ɛt ˈwɛr.bʊm ˈka.roː ˈfak.tʊm ɛst ɛt ha.bɪ.ˈtaː.wɪt ɪn ˈnoː.biːs/
q-vulg-verbum-caro.respelling: et WER-bum KA-roh FAK-tum est et ha-bi-TAH-wit in NOH-bees
q-vulg-verbum-caro.latin: Et Verbum carō factum est et habitāvit in nōbīs.

q-vulg-exiit-edictum.ipa: /ˈɛk.sɪ.ɪt eː.ˈdɪk.tʊm aː ˈkae̯.sa.rɛ au̯.ˈgʊs.toː ʊt deːs.kriː.bɛ.ˈreː.tʊr uː.nɪ.ˈwɛr.sʊs ˈɔr.bɪs/
q-vulg-exiit-edictum.respelling: EK-si-it ay-DIK-tum ah KEYE-sa-re ow-GUS-toh ut days-kree-be-RAY-tur oo-ni-WER-sus OR-bis
q-vulg-exiit-edictum.latin: Exiit ēdictum ā Caesare Augustō ut dēscrīberētur ūniversus orbis.

q-creed-pilato.ipa: /ˈpas.sʊs sʊb ˈpɔn.tɪ.oː piː.ˈlaː.toː krʊ.kɪ.ˈfiːk.sʊs ˈmɔr.tʊ.ʊs ɛt sɛ.ˈpʊl.tʊs/
q-creed-pilato.respelling: PAS-sus sub PON-ti-oh pee-LAH-toh kru-ki-FEEK-sus MOR-tu-us et se-PUL-tus
q-creed-pilato.latin: Passus sub Pontiō Pīlātō, crucifīxus, mortuus, et sepultus.

q-tacitus-christus.ipa: /ˈau̯k.tɔr ˈnoː.mɪ.nɪs ˈɛj.jʊs ˈkʰriːs.tʊs tɪ.ˈbɛ.rɪ.oː ɪm.pɛ.rɪ.ˈtan.tɛ pɛr proː.kuː.raː.ˈtoː.rɛm ˈpɔn.tɪ.ʊm piː.ˈlaː.tʊm sʊp.ˈplɪ.kɪ.oː ad.ˈfɛk.tʊs ˈɛ.rat/
q-tacitus-christus.respelling: OWK-tor NOH-mi-nis AY-yus KREES-tus ti-BE-ri-oh im-pe-ri-TAN-te per proh-koo-rah-TOH-rem PON-ti-um pee-LAH-tum sup-PLI-ki-oh ad-FEK-tus E-rat
q-tacitus-christus.latin: Auctor nōminis eius Chrīstus Tiberiō imperitante per prōcūrātōrem Pontium Pīlātum suppliciō adfectus erat.

q-pliny-carmen-christo.ipa: /ˈkar.mɛn ˈkʰriːs.toː ˈkʷa.sɪ ˈdɛ.oː ˈdiː.kɛ.rɛ ˈseː.kʊm ˈɪn.wɪ.kɛm/
q-pliny-carmen-christo.respelling: KAR-men KREES-toh KWA-si DE-oh DEE-ke-re SAY-kum IN-wi-kem
q-pliny-carmen-christo.latin: Carmen Chrīstō quasi deō dīcere sēcum invicem

q-jerome-capitur-urbs.respelling: KA-pi-tur urps kweye TOH-tum KAY-pit OR-bem
q-jerome-capitur-urbs.latin: Capitur urbs quae tōtum cēpit orbem.

q-bede-britannia.ipa: /brɪt.ˈta.nɪ.a oː.ˈkɛ.a.niː ˈiːn.sʊ.la kui̯ ˈkʷɔn.dam ˈal.bɪ.oːn ˈnoː.mɛn ˈfʊ.ɪt/
q-bede-britannia.respelling: brit-TA-ni-a oh-KE-a-nee EEN-su-la koo-ee KWON-dam AL-bi-ohn NOH-men FU-it
q-bede-britannia.latin: Brittania Ōceanī īnsula, cui quondam Albiōn nōmen fuit

q-benedict-mortem.respelling: MOR-tem ko-TEE-di-ay AN-te O-ku-lohs sus-PEK-tam ha-BAY-re
q-benedict-mortem.latin: Mortem cotīdiē ante oculōs suspectam habēre.

q-benedict-genera.respelling: mo-na-KOH-rum KWAT-tu-or ES-se GE-ne-ra ma-ni-FES-tum est
q-benedict-genera.latin: Monachōrum quattuor esse genera manifestum est.

q-isidore-litterae.ipa: /ˈlɪt.tɛ.rae̯ ˈau̯.tɛm sʊnt ˈɪn.dɪ.keːs ˈreː.rʊm ˈsɪŋ.na wɛr.ˈboː.rʊm ˈkʷɪ.bʊs ˈtan.ta wiːs ɛst ʊt ˈnoː.biːs ˈdɪk.ta ap.ˈsɛn.tɪ.ʊm ˈsɪ.nɛ ˈwoː.kɛ lɔ.ˈkʷan.tʊr/
q-isidore-litterae.respelling: LIT-te-reye OW-tem sunt IN-di-kays RAY-rum SING-na wer-BOH-rum KWI-bus TAN-ta wees est ut NOH-bees DIK-ta ap-SEN-ti-um SI-ne WOH-ke lo-KWAN-tur
q-isidore-litterae.latin: Litterae autem sunt indicēs rērum, signa verbōrum, quibus tanta vīs est, ut nōbīs dicta absentium sine vōce loquantur.

q-alcuin-vox-populi.ipa: /nɛk au̯.dɪ.ˈɛn.diː kʷiː ˈsɔ.lɛnt ˈdiː.kɛ.rɛ woːks ˈpɔ.pʊ.liː woːks ˈdɛ.iː/
q-alcuin-vox-populi.respelling: nek ow-di-EN-dee kwee SO-lent DEE-ke-re wohks PO-pu-lee wohks DE-ee
q-alcuin-vox-populi.latin: Nec audiendī quī solent dīcere: "Vōx populī, vōx Deī."

q-anselm-credo.ipa: /ˈnɛ.kʷɛ ˈɛ.nɪm ˈkʷae̯.roː ɪn.tɛl.ˈlɪ.gɛ.rɛ ʊt ˈkreː.dam sɛd ˈkreː.doː ʊt ɪn.ˈtɛl.lɪ.gam/
q-anselm-credo.respelling: NE-kwe E-nim KWEYE-roh in-tel-LI-ge-re ut KRAY-dam sed KRAY-doh ut in-TEL-li-gam
q-anselm-credo.latin: Neque enim quaerō intelligere ut crēdam, sed crēdō ut intelligam.

q-seneca-pauper.ipa: /noːn kʷiː ˈpa.rʊm ˈha.bɛt sɛd kʷiː pluːs ˈkʊ.pɪt ˈpau̯.pɛr ɛst/
q-seneca-pauper.respelling: nohn kwee PA-rum HA-bet sed kwee ploos KU-pit POW-per est
q-seneca-pauper.latin: Nōn quī parum habet, sed quī plūs cupit, pauper est.

q-seneca-philologia.respelling: kweye pi-lo-SO-pi-a FU-it FAK-ta pi-lo-LO-gi-a est
q-seneca-philologia.latin: Quae philosophia fuit, facta philologia est.

q-cicero-senex.ipa: /ˈneː.moː ˈɛ.nɪm ɛst tam ˈsɛ.nɛks kʷiː seː ˈan.nʊm noːn ˈpʊ.tɛt ˈpɔs.sɛ ˈwiː.wɛ.rɛ/
q-cicero-senex.respelling: NAY-moh E-nim est tam SE-neks kwee say AN-num nohn PU-tet POS-se WEE-we-re
q-cicero-senex.latin: Nēmō enim est tam senex quī sē annum nōn putet posse vīvere.

q-horace-caelum.ipa: /ˈkae̯.lʊm noːn ˈa.nɪ.mʊm ˈmuː.tant kʷiː traːns ˈma.rɛ ˈkʊr.rʊnt/
